Photographed 20/09/2021.

The large scale Ordnance Survey map of 1876 describes the building as the Castle Hotel.

The Listing details state that it was unoccupied and in a state of disrepair at the time of inspection, but it was evidently occupied and in a good state of repair when the Images of England photograph was taken in September 1999, a state that existed in September 2021 too.

There is evidence from the variation in the colours of the brickwork visible in the photograph that there was once a sloping roof attached to the main east wall of the building.
